authorization: Operator explicitly authorizes fixing a separate minimum internal-exchange hypothesis, preserving P1/PAH, and checking actual transfer and R158 phase compatibility with independent/hostile review and commit/push.

scope.space: Original side-16 periodic T^3; dimension three and spatial metric are inputs.
scope.regulator: For every fixed finite integer K>=1: exact Fourier trigonometric Psi in C^3 with |n_i|<=K; chi in C with |n_i|<=2K. Exact integrals and orthogonal variational projections, no collocation aliasing. The factor two admits the doubled R158 shell in chi BEFORE testing.
scope.measure_and_pairing: Lebesgue d^3x, original real L2 pairing; orthonormal Fourier coordinates. No Gibbs law, stochastic process, quantum state or physical projection is supplied.
scope.state: Arbitrary deterministic finite initial coordinates for dynamics. For statics use ALL global minimizers of H-mu*Qtotal on that same regulated phase space; no coherence phase or seed chosen to fit outcomes.
scope.time: New dimensionless canonical Hamiltonian parameter tau, {z,conjugate(z)}=-2i per orthonormal complex coordinate. Not A2 gradient, PAH Markov, proper or Lorentzian time.
scope.units: All new parameters and variables are nondimensional research inputs using the pinned P1 functional units, not fitted physical constants.
scope.limits: No K, volume, continuum, thermal or long-time limit. A bound uniform in finite K alone does not construct a limit.

model.unchanged_component: F_P1[Psi] exactly as R158; no coefficient, floor, reference or finite-part change.
model.dynamics: dot z=-2i*dH/d(conjugate z); equivalent real canonical Hamilton equations for every Fourier coefficient. One law for all initial conditions, no external source/mu(t)/reservoir reset.
model.symmetry: Intended weighted GLOBAL U(1): Psi -> exp(i theta)Psi, chi -> exp(2i theta)chi. No local gauge invariance or full U(3) is asserted.
model.chemical_potential_role: mu is solely the Lagrange multiplier conjugate to total charge for comparing equilibria, NOT an imposed time history, a prediction, or a derived cosmological parameter. No equilibration or reservoir tracing is assumed.

preregistered_tests: Derive exact total-charge conservation and nonzero component exchange at an admissible initial state; prove the finite-dimensional flow is complete on each nonnegative total-charge level.
Test exact inheritance of original R158 mu_t, shell minimizer and coexistence: include reservoir variations, not just a frozen coherent chi Hessian.

If exact inheritance fails, without changing any coefficient, test whether the SAME parent nevertheless has a shifted finite-volume variational first-order coexistence with an explicit bound on the shift. This secondary criterion is declared now, not introduced after a failed result.

Use R158 nonnegative decomposition and |S|<=rho to bound the reservoir correction for a=omega/2-mu>0 by -epsilon^2*rho^2/(4a). Assess compactness and nonzero charge jump separately; no numerical phase sweep.
Run independent real-component and hostile convention/domain/state/limit audits, and partial parameterized Lean algebra where available.
pass_fail_meaning: EXACT_INHERITANCE and CONTROLLED_SHIFTED_COMPATIBILITY are distinct verdicts. Actual exchange does not prove either. A shifted finite-regulator variational transition, if proved, is not thermodynamic criticality or a physical realization of R158.
falsifiers: A charge-sign/factor failure, no actual exchange, unbounded regulated flow, invalid reservoir comparison, loss of all controlled coexistence, or a missing compactness/jump argument blocks the corresponding proposition. No coefficient fitting, new term, phase averaging, selected observable or time change is allowed.
non_claims: New hypothetical classical finite-regulator parent only. No original P1/PAH modification, physical reservoir or clock, Gibbs relaxation, quantum condensate, physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, GR, continuum, mass gap or TOE. No A13 owner or T054 gate closure.
